items.stem: Why does usable energy decrease at each higher trophic level?

options.text: Energy is lost as heat and through life processes
options.rationale: Correct: energy is lost as heat and in respiration and movement at each level.
Energy is not created; it is transferred and lost.

options.text: Higher levels do not use any energy
options.rationale: All organisms use energy to live.

options.text: Producers take all the energy back
options.rationale: Producers capture light energy but do not reclaim it from consumers.

items.explanation: Correct: energy is lost as heat and in respiration and movement at each level.

items.stem: Which of the following is an abiotic factor in an ecosystem?

options.rationale: Correct: temperature is a non-living (abiotic) factor.
A fox is a living, biotic factor.
Grass is a living, biotic factor.

items.explanation: Correct: temperature is a non-living (abiotic) factor.
